prompt: Editorial typography poster design, mobile portrait 9:16 ratio. Pure flat off-white paper background #FBFBF6 filling the entire canvas — absolutely no photography, no illustration, no decorative elements, no environment. The dominant visual element is the word "BOOK" set as a monumental single extra-bold grotesk sans-serif letterform, scaled to nearly fill the full viewport width, positioned in the upper-center of the canvas, in deep black #0A0A0A. The bottom half of each letter of "BOOK" is mid-fragmentation: the horizontal strokes and curves are breaking apart into a dense vertical rain of small black letterforms and typographic debris cascading downward like a letterstorm, pulling apart and drifting toward the bottom of the canvas. As this cascade reaches the lower third of the canvas, the falling letters reorganize and coalesce into the form of the words "with your artist" set in a smaller elegant serif italic, in black, horizontally centered. Exactly one letterform in the upper "BOOK" word is rendered in metallic silver #C9C9C9 instead of black, appearing mid-transformation. Top-left corner: a small black grotesk wordmark "NAP". Bottom edge of the canvas: a solid black horizontal bar spanning the full width with the white text "Ride the storm" centered. The mood is dream-surreal, alphabet-as-weather, type behaving as physical matter. High contrast, dramatic negative space, flat two-color poster art with one silver accent.
